title: Find students with course requests includes subject 1 area and department
description: Find students with course requests includes subject 1 area and department - Run at your school. Will show all students who have 1 or more requests, one line per request, course number, and course name. Additionally, this will show subject area 1 and deparment
code: LIST STU SSS CRS STU.ID STU.LN STU.FN STU.NG STU.SC STU.NS SSS.CN CRS.CO CRS.S1? CRS.DC? IF ( STU.TG = "*" OR STU.TG = "" )
